game.name: World War Z
game.desc: An intense, four-player cooperative third-person shooter that challenges teams to survive overwhelming, fast-moving zombie swarms in locations around the globe, emphasizing class roles, defensive preparations, and coordinated action to manage the massive undead hordes.
